pages.text: Necromancers can be given summoning foci beyond the ordinary ones; each summon has a chance to add an extra summon, with its own separate cap.$(br)Wither Necromancers have a 75%% chance, and a summon that brings nothing guarantees the next extra summon. Other necromancers have a 50%% chance, and after two summons with nothing the next one is guaranteed.

A necromancer can only be given summoning foci for extra summons after it has been upgraded with a soul jar once.$(br)Necromancers start with a single extra-summon slot (Green Smith has three). They can be expanded with the Forbidden Cheat Sheet, up to two expansions, for at most five extra-summon focus slots.
Wither Necromancers use the $(l:world/bestiary/wither_necromancer)Withered Manuscript$() instead.
